sentences.text: Dated this the 17th day of January, 2024 This is an application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed by the sole accused in Crime No.592 of 2023 of Kadinamkulam Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram, registered under Sections 498A and 306 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The prosecution allegation is that on 16.05.2023 at a time between 5.00 pm - 6.00 pm, the wife of the petitioner Smt. Anju aged 22 years, committed suicide by self immolation, and her 9 month old baby also suffered burn injuries, and he died on the next day in hospital.
The allegation is that the petitioner subjected her to matrimonial cruelties, and abetted her to commit suicide along with her child.

.. 3..
3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the incident occurred on 16.05.2023, and the petitioner was available in station throughout and he never absconded.
He is ready to abide by any conditions imposed by this Court.
5. The facts alleged would reveal that a 22 year old girl and her 9 month old baby committed suicide by setting fire, while she was preparing for attending a visa interview for going to UK.

It is quite strange an argument by learned counsel for the petitioner that, due to her mental stress that, she could not return the gold ornaments which she had borrowed from her relatives to meet the expenses for visa, she committed suicide.

An young lady aged only 22, who was aspiring to go abroad by making cash arrangements by borrowing money or gold from relatives, and waiting to attend the visa interview may not commit suicide unless otherwise there were compelling reasons for the same, ..4..
especially when she was having a breast feeding baby.
The real reason behind the incident has to be unfurled after a proper investigation, for which the presence of the petitioner is absolutely necessary.
So, this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
6. The petitioner is at liberty to appear before the Investigating Officer on 23.01.2024 at 10.00 am and subject himself for interrogation.
In the event of his arrest, he shall be produced before the jurisdictional Magistrate on the date of arrest itself.
With the above direction, this bail application stands dismissed.

Sd/-
